column3: CI runs on Instabox: a dispatcher VM takes the repo webhook and leases 4 of 8 persistent 8 vCPU runners per head SHA (one checks runner, three test shards), each reused with a clean checkout instead of a fresh VM per job
column4: Keyur: replace Actions with Instabox VMs, under 60 s from push to last status. A VM from a snapshot took 40-175 s to create when several started at once (3 s alone from a template), while a paused runner resumes in about 3 s
column5: PR 114 head: 63.8 s on 3 shards; PR 123 head (faster test files): 48.5 s, ready 4.9 s after the push, shards 33-40 s
